title: SUNDRIFT
models: Claude Fable 5.1 wrote the code, the assets and judged the candidates and the critic rounds
no image or audio model: there are no image or audio files, every texture and sound is generated in code at load
what_i_found: The clock is a score: every banked drift pushes the night toward dawn, so the moonlight, the street lamps, the sunrise and the golden hour that follows are driven by how well you drive, and a long chain visibly swings the light across the pass. Also: one-finger phone drifting, with counter-steer that scales with slip so a thumb can hold a 50-degree angle without spinning.
